tasks.title: make_server lifecycle: port, start/stop, context manager, token roles, GET /health

argv:
import sys, json, os, tempfile, urllib.request, urllib.error
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import inv_api
s = inv_api.make_server(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'a.db'), {'adm': 'admin', 'rd': 'reader'}).start()
def call(m, p, b=None, tok='adm'):
    req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:%d%s' % (s.port, p), method=m, data=None if b is None else json.dumps(b).encode(), headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + tok} if tok else {})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r: return r.status, json.loads(r.read() or 'null'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code, json.loads(e.read() or 'null'), dict(e.headers)
print(call('GET','/health',tok=None)[:2], s.port > 0)
s.stop()

import sys, json, os, tempfile, urllib.request, urllib.error
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import inv_api
db=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'a.db'); s = inv_api.make_server(db, {'adm': 'admin'}).start()
def call(m, p, b=None, tok='adm'):
    req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:%d%s' % (s.port, p), method=m, data=None if b is None else json.dumps(b).encode(), headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + tok} if tok else {})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r: return r.status, json.loads(r.read() or 'null'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code, json.loads(e.read() or 'null'), dict(e.headers)
call('POST','/products',{'sku':'A1','name':'Apple','price_cents':100}); call('POST','/products/A1/stock',{'delta':7,'reason':'in'}); s.stop()
s = inv_api.make_server(db, {'adm': 'admin'}).start(); print(call('GET','/products/A1')[1]['stock'], call('GET','/products/A1/movements')[1]['total']); s.stop()

import sys, json, os, tempfile, urllib.request, urllib.error
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import inv_api
s = inv_api.make_server(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'a.db'), {'adm': 'admin', 'rd': 'reader'}).start()
def call(m, p, b=None, tok='adm'):
    req = urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:%d%s' % (s.port, p), method=m, data=None if b is None else json.dumps(b).encode(), headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + tok} if tok else {})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r: return r.status, json.loads(r.read() or 'null'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code, json.loads(e.read() or 'null'), dict(e.headers)
import threading
call('POST','/products',{'sku':'A1','name':'a','price_cents':1}); call('POST','/products/A1/stock',{'delta':5,'reason':'in'}); res=[]
def w(): res.append(call('POST','/products/A1/stock',{'delta':-1,'reason':'out'})[0])
ts=[threading.Thread(target=w) for _ in range(12)]
[t.start() for t in ts]; [t.join() for t in ts]
print(res.count(200), res.count(409), call('GET','/products/A1')[1]['stock'])
s.stop()
